description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically for handling the view logic of module fields within the ModuleBuilder interface. It defines the ViewModulefields class, which manages displaying and editing module field definitions in the Studio. The class includes methods for rendering the interface, loading language files, filtering fields, and validating fields for editing purposes.

classes.name: ViewModulefields
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for displaying and managing module field definitions within the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder, including handling different packaging contexts and interfacing with Smarty templates.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module view, including translation of 'LBL_MODULE_NAME' and the module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to display the module fields interface. Handles both studio and packaged scenarios, loading field definitions, preparing data for templates, and generating AJAX responses for the frontend.

methods.name: loadPackageHelp
methods.description: Sets help information for a given module package, indicating whether creating or modifying.

methods.name: cullFields
methods.description: Removes unused or unnecessary fields from field definitions, such as 'parent_id', 'parent_type', and 'currency_id'.

methods.name: isValidStudioField
methods.description: Determines if a given field definition qualifies as a valid studio field based on its properties.
